title.original: Metal-Sci: A Scientific Compute Benchmark for Evolutionary LLM Kernel Search on Apple Silicon
title.zh: Metal-Sci：Apple Silicon上演进式LLM内核搜索的科学计算基准
title.en: Metal-Sci: A Scientific Compute Benchmark for Evolutionary LLM Kernel Search on Apple Silicon

inclusion_reason.zh: Metal-Sci 发布任务套件、CPU oracle、roofline 适应度、搜索 harness 和隐藏 gate，是自动 kernel 优化的评测基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: Metal-Sci releases tasks, CPU oracles, roofline fitness, a search harness, and a hidden gate as evaluation infrastructure for automated kernel optimization.

abstract.zh: Metal-Sci 提供面向 Apple Silicon 的科学计算 kernel 基准与自动搜索 harness，让冻结 LLM 在编译、正确性和 roofline 反馈下进行进化优化，并用隐藏规模检验泛化。
abstract.en: Metal-Sci provides scientific-compute kernels and an automated Apple-Silicon search harness in which a frozen LLM evolves code from compile, correctness, and roofline feedback, with hidden sizes testing generalization.

problem.zh: 自动 kernel 搜索容易只记住公开尺寸，在训练内基准上变快却在新规模产生错误或性能崩溃；Apple Metal 也缺少统一评测套件。
problem.en: Automated kernel search can overfit visible sizes, becoming fast in-loop while failing or regressing on unseen shapes, and Apple Metal lacks a common evaluation suite.

approach.zh: 每项任务提供 CPU oracle、roofline 适应度和隐藏规模；harness 运行时编译候选、逐尺寸检查并把结构化反馈送回单亲进化循环。
approach.en: Each task supplies a CPU oracle, roofline-based fitness, and a hidden size; the harness runtime-compiles candidates, checks each size, and feeds structured diagnostics into a one-parent evolutionary loop.

system_design.zh: LLM 生成 Metal 候选，编译/执行沙箱产出错误与性能，适应度选择下一代；搜索结束后只执行一次隐藏 gate，阻止过拟合 kernel 被接受。
system_design.en: The LLM generates Metal candidates, a compile/execute sandbox returns errors and timing, fitness selects the next generation, and a one-time hidden gate rejects overfit kernels at the end.

key_results.zh: 多模型搜索产生明显加速，但隐藏 gate 也捕获了训练内看似最优、在未见规模上错误或退化的候选，验证其机械监督价值。
key_results.en: Several model searches find substantial speedups, while the hidden gate catches candidates that look best in-loop but fail or regress on unseen sizes, validating its oversight role.

limitations.zh: 基准任务数量和硬件集中于 Apple Silicon 单一层级，隐藏规模只能捕获部分过拟合；模型版本、搜索预算和编译器更新会影响可复现性。
limitations.en: The suite is small and centered on one Apple-Silicon tier, a single hidden size catches only some overfitting, and model versions, search budgets, and compiler updates affect reproducibility.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
